records.text: Therefore, as I live, says the Lord of powers, the God of Israel, Moab will be like Sodom and the Ammonites like Gomorrah, and Damascus abandoned like a heap on a threshing floor and vanished forever. My people’s remnant will plunder them; My nation’s remnant will inherit them.
And the Lord rained upon Sodom and Gomorrah sulphur and fire from the Lord out of the heaven;
and He overthrew those cities, and all the surrounding country, and all that lived in the cities, and all that sprang from the earth.
The utterance against Damascus. Behold, Damascus will be removed from the cities and become a ruin,
abandoned for everlasting time, a bed and resting place for flocks, with no one pursuing.
This will be theirs for their arrogance, because they reproached and exalted themselves against the Lord Almighty.
We heard Moab’s insolence—exceedingly insolent. You raised up your arrogance. Your divination is not so,
not so. Moab will wail, for all in Moab’s country will wail. You will ponder for Deseth’s residents and not be ashamed.
The Lord will appear against them and destroy all the gods of the nations of the earth. All the islands of the nations will worship Him, each from his place.

“For from the sun’s rising to its setting, My name has been glorified among the nations, and in every place incense is brought to My name, together with a pure sacrifice, because My name is great among the nations,” says the Lord Almighty.
You too, Ethiopians, are slain by My sword.
For the Lord’s day is near; it will be a day, an end of nations.
A sword will come upon the Egyptians, and there will be turmoil in Ethiopia; wounded men will fall in Egypt, and her foundations will collapse together.
Persians, Cretans, Lydians, Libyans, all the mixed company, and some of the sons of My covenant will fall by the sword in her.
Egypt’s supports will fall, and the arrogance of her strength will come down from Migdol to Syene; they will fall in her by the sword, says the Lord.
He will stretch His hand against the north and destroy the Assyrian, making Nineveh a waterless wasteland like a wilderness.
and everyone seeing you will spring away and say, “Miserable Nineveh! Who will lament her? Where shall I seek consolation for her?”

Flocks and all the wild animals of the earth will graze within her; chameleons and hedgehogs will lie in her recessed panels. Wild animals will cry in her openings, and ravens in her gateways, for cedar is her structure.
night and day. It will not be quenched for an everlasting time, and her smoke will rise upward. For generations and a long time she will be deserted.
Birds, hedgehogs, ibises and ravens will dwell in her; a measuring cord for deserted land will be cast upon her, and donkey-centaurs will dwell in her.
Her rulers will be no more, for her kings, her rulers and her magnates will come to destruction.
Thorny trees will sprout in their cities and her fortifications; she will become a dwelling for sirens and a courtyard for ostriches.
Demons will meet donkey-centaurs and cry one to another. There donkey-centaurs will rest, for they found rest for themselves.
There a hedgehog nested, and the earth kept her children safe. There deer met and saw one another’s faces;

This is the contemptuous city dwelling in confidence, saying in her heart, “I am, and there is no one after me.” How she became a wasteland, pasture for wild animals! Everyone passing through her will hiss and wave his hands.
Now hear these things, pampered one who sits confident, saying in her heart, ‘I am, and there is no other. I will not sit as a widow or know bereavement.’
Now these two will come upon you suddenly, in one day: widowhood and childlessness will come suddenly upon you, amid your sorcery and the overwhelming power of your enchanters,

in your hope of wickedness. For you said, ‘I am, and there is no other.’ Know that understanding these things and your prostitution will become your shame. You said in your heart, ‘I am, and there is no other.’

Destruction will come upon you, and you will certainly not know it—a pit, and you will fall into it. Misery will come upon you, and you will certainly not be able to become clean. Destruction will come upon you suddenly, and you will certainly not know it.
She did not heed a voice or accept discipline; she did not trust the Lord or approach her God.

And when the Lord sent you forth from Kadesh-barnea, saying: Go up and inherit the land which I give you, you disobeyed the word of the Lord your God, and did not believe Him, and did not hearken unto His voice.
You were disobedient toward the Lord from the day when He became known unto you.
Her rulers within her are like roaring lions; her judges are like Arabian wolves, leaving nothing for morning.
Her leaders within her are like roaring lions seizing prey, devouring lives with power, taking payments unjustly, and your widows have multiplied within you.

Her priests set aside My law and profaned My holy things. They did not distinguish between holy and profane, nor distinguish between unclean and clean. They covered their eyes from My Sabbaths, and I was profaned among them.
Her rulers within her are like wolves seizing prey to shed blood, so that in greed they may gain more.
Her prophets are bearers of a spirit, contemptuous men; her priests profane holy things and act impiously toward law.
Her prophets, coating them, will fall, seeing vain things, divining falsehoods, saying, “Thus says the Lord,” when the Lord has not spoken,

But the Lord is righteous within her and will certainly do no injustice. Morning by morning He will bring His judgment to light; He was not hidden and knew no injustice in exaction, nor injustice in strife.
God—true are His works, and all His ways are judgments; a faithful God, and there is no unrighteousness; righteous and holy is the Lord.
In destruction I tore down the proud; their corners vanished. I will make their roads utterly desolate, with no passing through; their cities failed because no one existed or dwelt there.
and I will make your cities desolate, and lay waste your holy places; and I will in no wise smell the savour of your sacrifices;
and I Myself will desolate your land, and your enemies who dwell in it shall marvel at it.

Son, do not make light of the Lord’s discipline or lose heart when corrected by Him,
for the Lord disciplines the one He loves and scourges every son He receives.

Therefore wait for Me, says the Lord, for the day of My rising for testimony. My judgment is for assemblies of nations, to receive kings and pour all My furious wrath upon them; for all the earth will be consumed in My jealous fire.

For then I will change a tongue for peoples, for its generation, so that all call upon the Lord’s name and serve Him under one yoke.
And the Lord said, “Behold, they are one people, and all have one language; and this they have begun to do. And now nothing that they purpose to do shall fail them.
“Come, let Us go down and confound their language there, so that they may no longer understand one another’s speech.”
And the Lord scattered them from there over the face of the whole earth, and they ceased building the city and the tower.

From the far reaches of Ethiopia’s rivers they will bring sacrifices to Me.

all are like an inhabited country; their country will be inhabited as when a signal is raised from a mountain, and it will be audible like a trumpet’s voice.
For thus the Lord said to me, “There will be security in My city, like the light of midday heat, and it will be like a dew cloud on a harvest day.”

and leave them together for heaven’s birds and the earth’s wild beasts. Heaven’s birds will gather upon them, and all the earth’s wild beasts will come upon him.

For the Lord’s eyes are high, but the human being is low; humanity’s height will be humbled, and the Lord alone will be exalted on that day.

the remnant of Israel; they will do no injustice or speak vain things, and no deceitful tongue will be found in their mouth. For they will graze and lie down, and no one will frighten them.

Rejoice greatly, daughter Zion! Proclaim, daughter Jerusalem! Be glad and delight with all your heart, daughter Jerusalem!
Rejoice greatly, daughter Zion; proclaim, daughter Jerusalem. Behold, your king comes to you, righteous and saving, gentle, and mounted upon a beast of burden and a young colt.

“Delight and rejoice, daughter Zion, for look, I am coming and will dwell within you,” says the Lord.
At that time the Lord will say to Jerusalem, “Take courage, Zion; do not let your hands hang loose.
Be strong, limp hands and paralyzed knees!
Give encouragement, you fainthearted in mind. Be strong; do not fear! Behold, our God repays judgment and will repay; He Himself will come and save us.
The Lord your God is within you; mighty, He shall save you. He shall bring gladness upon you, and renew you in His love; and He shall rejoice over you with delight, as on a day of feasting.”
As a young man lives with a virgin, so your sons will dwell with you. As a bridegroom rejoices over a bride, so the Lord will rejoice over you.

“On that day,” says the Lord, “I will gather the crushed one, receive the expelled one and those I rejected.
I will make the crushed one a remnant and the rejected one a strong nation. The Lord will reign over them on Mount Zion from now and forever.
Look, I am acting within you for your sake at that time, says the Lord. I will save the oppressed and the rejected; I will receive them and make them a boast and renowned throughout the earth.

They will be ashamed at that time, when I do good to you and when I receive you. I will make you renowned and a boast among all the earth’s peoples, when I turn your captivity before you, says the Lord.
I will bring back Judah’s exiles and Israel’s exiles and build them as before.
I will cleanse them from all the injustices by which they sinned against Me. I will certainly not remember the sins they committed against Me when they departed from Me.

It will be for joy, praise, and greatness to all the people of the earth. They will hear all the good things I will do, and they will fear and be distressed over all the good and peace I will bring them.

triples.source_text: I will gather the crushed. Alas! Who took up reproach against her?

target_units.text: “On that day,” says the Lord, “I will gather the crushed one, receive the expelled one and those I rejected.
I will make the crushed one a remnant and the rejected one a strong nation. The Lord will reign over them on Mount Zion from now and forever.

triples.relationship: reception of rejected and afflicted people
triples.rationale: Zephaniah promises to save the oppressed and receive the rejected; Micah promises to receive the expelled and rejected and make them a strong nation. Both reverse exclusion through God's reception.
triples.source_text: Look, I am acting within you for your sake at that time, says the Lord. I will save the oppressed and the rejected; I will receive them and make them a boast and renowned throughout the earth.

target_units.text: “On that day,” says the Lord, “I will gather the crushed one, receive the expelled one and those I rejected.
I will make the crushed one a remnant and the rejected one a strong nation. The Lord will reign over them on Mount Zion from now and forever.

triples.relationship: restoration bringing public praise among the earth's peoples
triples.rationale: Zephaniah promises returned captivity and renown among all peoples; Jeremiah promises to bring back Judah's and Israel's exiles and make the restoration a cause of praise and greatness before the earth's people.
triples.source_text: They will be ashamed at that time, when I do good to you and when I receive you. I will make you renowned and a boast among all the earth’s peoples, when I turn your captivity before you, says the Lord.

target_units.text: I will bring back Judah’s exiles and Israel’s exiles and build them as before.
I will cleanse them from all the injustices by which they sinned against Me. I will certainly not remember the sins they committed against Me when they departed from Me.

It will be for joy, praise, and greatness to all the people of the earth. They will hear all the good things I will do, and they will fear and be distressed over all the good and peace I will bring them.
